facts.text: I finished The Last of Us Part II on normal difficulty.
It took me 25 hours to complete The Last of Us Part II.
I found the normal difficulty to be a good balance between challenge and storytelling.
I was able to focus on the narrative and characters without getting too frustrated with the gameplay.
I didn't know it took the developers 5-6 years to develop The Last of Us Part II.
I haven't played any of the recommended games yet.
I have heard great things about What Remains of Edith Finch.
I have heard great things about Firewatch.
I think I will give What Remains of Edith Finch or Firewatch a try.
I think I will check out ResetEra.
I think I will check out Reddit's r/Games.
I am interested in learning more about the gaming industry and staying up-to-date with the latest news and developments.
I think I will start with Polygon for written articles.
I think I will start with Kotaku for written articles.
I think I will check out YouTube channels like GameSpot.
I think I will check out YouTube channels like Jimquisition.
I have heard great things about Jim Sterling's in-depth analysis and critique of the gaming industry.
I might listen to the Game Informer Show podcast.
I have enjoyed their magazine in the past.
I have been thinking about getting a new gaming keyboard.
